teams.title: Pokémon Team Builder: Showdown Formats, Legality Checked
teams.description: A Pokémon team builder for competitive teams in Gen 9 OU, Ubers, UU, Doubles OU, VGC, National Dex, Gen 4 OU and Gen 3 OU. Moves from each format's learnsets, live stats, Showdown import / export and Pokémon Showdown's own legality check.
teams.heading: Team
teams.intro: A Pokémon team builder with six slots, every format's learnsets and Pokémon Showdown's own rules. Teams save on this device as you build, ready for battle.

lab.title: Battle Lab — Pokémon Win Probability Simulator
lab.description: Set up any two Pokémon teams, Gen 1 to 9, and run the battle thousands of times on Pokémon Showdown's own engine. See each side's win chance with a 95% confidence interval, how long battles last, who scores the KOs, and watch sample battles.
lab.name: Battle Lab
lab.heading: Battle
lab.intro: Set up two sides and let Pokémon Showdown's own engine play the battle thousands of times, right in your browser. See how often each side wins, how long it takes and what decides it.

ladder.title: Pokémon Battle Ladder — Ranked Ratings by Format
ladder.description: The ranked battle ladder: Elo, GXE and Glicko-2 ratings, as on Pokémon Showdown, for Random Battle, Random Doubles, OU, Ubers, UU, RU, NU, PU, LC, Monotype, National Dex and Doubles OU.
ladder.heading: Battle
ladder.rules: Ratings per format as on Pokémon Showdown: the ladder is ranked by Elo (everyone starts at {elo}, never drops below it, and an Elo above 1400 decays a little each day you don't play), shown with GXE (your chance of beating a random trainer on the ladder) and a Glicko-2 rating. Everyone starts at {rating} ± {rd} Glicko-2; a rating is provisional until its deviation drops below {shown}. A forfeit, running out the clock or leaving counts as a loss.
ladder.short: Ranked by Elo, with GXE and Glicko-2, as on Pokémon Showdown. Everyone starts at {elo}.

insights.title: Team insights
insights.description: Your battle insights: leads, Pokémon, toughest opponents and rating over time.
insights.heading: Team
insights.intro: Your most common leads, win rate per Pokémon, the foes that beat you most and your rating over time, from your saved battles.
insights.signIn: Insights follow your account: sign in to see yours.

replays.title: Pokémon Battle Replays
replays.description: Watch Pokémon battle replays turn by turn, on Pokémon Showdown's engine: your own battles and the latest ranked and public ones.
replays.heading: Battle
replays.intro: Every ranked and public battle is saved as a replay; after any other, press Save replay. Replays show what spectators saw, turn by turn.

replay.fallbackDescription: A Pokémon battle replay on PokéIQ.

notFound.heading: Replay not found
notFound.body: This replay doesn't exist or isn't available: the link may be wrong, or the battle was never saved.

import.title: Watch a Showdown Replay
import.description: Paste a Pokémon Showdown battle log or open a saved replay file and watch it turn by turn.
import.heading: Watch a
import.intro: Paste a battle log, or open a replay file Showdown saved, and play it back here.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.description: Pokémon battle tournaments on PokéIQ: single elimination or round robin in any format, plus an official Random Battle tournament every hour.
tournaments.heading: Tournaments
tournaments.intro: Join a bracket, or open your own in any format. An official Random Battle tournament starts every hour: sign-ups are open for the first ten minutes.

tournament.title: Tournament
tournament.description: A Pokémon battle tournament on PokéIQ: the live bracket, matches and results.
